purpose: Teach: レクチャー/手放し/首位/バスケット/お宝/石垣/掘っ/オーロラ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、ぼくに、宿題のレクチャー、本気で、してくれたんだよ、本当に、ありがたいよ、絶対。
lines.en: Mom, Dad really gave me a proper homework lesson. I'm so grateful for that, honestly.
lines.style: Warm, genuine gratitude. Soft but clear delivery. Speaks directly to both parents, eyes bright. No rush—letting each word land. Slight rise at the end, seeking their warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さん、手放しで、翔くんのこと、褒めてたわよ、本気で、誇りに、思ってるのよ、絶対、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Yes. Your dad was praising you without reservation. He's genuinely proud of you—I can tell. It makes me happy.
lines.style: Warm, maternal. Steady conviction in her voice. Speaks as though sharing a secret that isn't really a secret. Soft but sure, with a little exhale of relief underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: クラスで、ぼく、テストの結果、本気で、首位、取ったんだよ、ママ、本当に、嬉しいんだ、絶対、誇り、頑張った。
lines.en: I came first in the test at school, Mom. I really did it. I'm so happy about it—I worked hard for that.
lines.style: Bright, genuine pride without boasting. Direct eye contact. Speaks a little faster, energy building. Lands on the effort—not just the result. Small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: バスケットボール、本気で、続けていきたいって、翔くん、お父さんに、伝えてたわね、本当に、応援してるよ、絶対、本気。
lines.en: You told your dad you want to keep playing basketball, didn't you? We're cheering for you—really, genuinely.
lines.style: Warm, steady support. Slightly slower delivery to underscore her sincerity. A mother's quiet conviction, not theatrical. Speaks with the certainty of someone already imagining his future.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの倉庫、お宝、本気で、たくさん、ありそうだよ、ママ、ぼく、見たいよ、絶対、本気で、楽しみ。
lines.en: Grandpa's storage has so many treasures in it, I bet. Mom, I really want to look inside. I'm so excited about it.
lines.style: Animated, bursting with curiosity. Quick rhythm, voice climbing with each thought. Barely contains himself—the energy of a child imagining adventure. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昔の城跡、本気で、石垣、家族で、見に行きたいわね、翔くん、お父さんに、相談してみようね、絶対、本気で、楽しみ。
lines.en: I'd love to visit that old castle ruins with the family—those stone walls. Let's talk to your dad about it, shall we? I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently reflective. Speaks as if turning the idea over in her mind even as she says it. Inviting, not directive. A mother imagining a family memory. Warm underlying current of anticipation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 庭で、お父さん、本気で、穴、掘ったんだよ、ママ、見て、すごいよね、本気で、感心しちゃう、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Dad dug a real hole in the garden, Mom. Look—isn't that amazing? I'm really impressed by it, honestly.
lines.style: Admiring, almost awestruck at the simple adult feat. Speaks with genuine wonder at his father's capability. Points with his voice. Slightly slower pace, savoring the detail. Pure, unselfconscious respect.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、オーロラ、見に行ったって、本気で、お話してくれたよね、翔くん、本当に、ロマンチック、絶対。
lines.en: Your grandfather told us he went to see the aurora when he was young, remember? That's so romantic. Truly magical.
lines.style: Wistful, slightly dreamy. Speaks as though that memory is precious to her too. Quieter, more intimate register. A moment of shared wonder between mother and son. Trails off gently at the end, savoring the image.
